svg.title: 21. Palm up wrist stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Reach one arm forwards with the palm up. Let the fingers point towards the ground. Use the other hand on the palm to bend the wrist gently back.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://nismat.org/patient-care/patient-education/injury-prevention/exercise-programs/upper-extremity-and-neck-flexibility-program/
